requiredChecks: Verify the target hostname is allocated and hosted HTTPS owner access works.
Inventory existing redirect rules and every website alias before replacing any routing configuration.
Publish only the generated public directory; original website resources must not remain at the old origin.
Verify redirects for every listed old path, including query strings and a browser fragment probe.
Verify Auth recovery/confirmation and username-login against the actual canonical origin.
Keep production maintenance OFF and the activation interlock locked until routing and database enforcement are verified.
